hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_BRANCH} | cut -d "/" -f 2` GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_COMMIT} | cut -c1-7`
# bdc.env moved from a stack-independent key to a per-stack one. Accept the old location while # the copy is outstanding, and stop with instructions when neither exists: a frontend image built # without it has no LOGGING_API_KEY and silently drops every audit event. if aws s3api get-object --bucket $stack_s3_bucket --key "configs/pic-sure-frontend/$TARGET_STACK/bdc.env" .env >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Using configs/pic-sure-frontend/$TARGET_STACK/bdc.env" elif aws s3api get-object --bucket $stack_s3_bucket --key "configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env" .env >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARNING: configs/pic-sure-frontend/$TARGET_STACK/bdc.env is missing; using the pre-migration configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env instead." >&2 echo "WARNING: that object has no stack segment, so every stack builds from it. Upload a per-stack copy to finish the migration." >&2 else echo "ERROR: no bdc.env found for stack $TARGET_STACK." >&2 echo "ERROR: looked for s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/$TARGET_STACK/bdc.env" >&2 echo "ERROR: and s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env" >&2 echo "ERROR:" >&2 echo "ERROR: The image bakes this file in as .env, so building without it ships a frontend with" >&2 echo "ERROR: no LOGGING_API_KEY. This build stops here instead." >&2 echo "ERROR: To fix it:" >&2 echo "ERROR: 1. Get a starting file: run 'Download PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration' against a" >&2 echo "ERROR: stack that has one, or copy .env.example from the PIC-SURE-Frontend repository." >&2 echo "ERROR: 2. Set LOGGING_API_KEY to the value in this stack's rendered" >&2 echo "ERROR: configs/pic-sure-logging/$TARGET_STACK/logging.env. A mismatch is not fatal, but" >&2 echo "ERROR: pic-sure-logging answers the frontend's audit events with 401 and they are dropped." >&2 echo "ERROR: 3. Upload it with 'Upload PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration', TARGET_STACK=$TARGET_STACK." >&2 echo "ERROR: 4. Re-run this build." >&2 exit 1 fi aws s3api get-object --bucket $stack_s3_bucket --key "configs/pic-sure-frontend/configuration.json" configuration.json
cp -f configuration.json ./src/lib/assets/configuration.json
docker build --no-cache --load -f Dockerfile --build-arg THEME=${THEME} -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}_${TARGET_STACK} . docker save hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}_${TARGET_STACK} | gzip > pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz
